description: Summary figure from the computed Foldseek, Smith-Waterman and orthology results for LPX2
code:
import os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("files in cwd:", sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith((".csv",".pdb",".npy"))))

fs_core = pd.read_csv("foldseek_P35736_core.csv")
fs_ctrl = pd.read_csv("foldseek_Q12405_LPX1.csv")
sw      = pd.read_csv("lpx2_sw_alignment_table.csv")

def classify(t):
    t=t.lower()
    if "eisosome" in t: return "Eis1 family"
    if "hydrolase" in t or "lpx1" in t or "esterase" in t or "lipase" in t: return "alpha/beta hydrolase"
    return "other / noise"
fs_core["cls"]=fs_core.target.map(classify); fs_ctrl["cls"]=fs_ctrl.target.map(classify)
fs_ctrl=fs_ctrl[fs_ctrl.seqId<99.9]   # drop self-hit

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.28)

# A: Foldseek E-values, LPX2 core query
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
cols={"Eis1 family":"#4C78A8","alpha/beta hydrolase":"#E45756","other / noise":"#BAB0AC"}
d=fs_core.sort_values("eval")
y=np.arange(len(d))
ax.barh(y,-np.log10(d["eval"].clip(lower=1e-300)),color=[cols[c] for c in d.cls])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([t.split(" ",1)[0] for t in d.target],fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("-log10 Foldseek E-value")
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.001),color="#555",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_title("A  Foldseek: LPX2 high-confidence core (317 aa)\nall significant hits are Eis1-family; 0 hits in PDB100",fontsize=9,loc="left")

# B: positive control
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
d2=fs_ctrl.sort_values("eval").head(14); y=np.arange(len(d2))
ax.barh(y,-np.log10(d2["eval"].clip(lower=1e-300)),color=[cols[c] for c in d2.cls])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([t[:44] for t in d2.target],fontsize=7)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("-log10 Foldseek E-value")
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.001),color="#555",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_title("B  Positive control: LPX1 (Q12405) full model\nretrieves its own crystal structure 2Y6V and AB-hydrolase-1 models",fontsize=9,loc="left")

# C: Smith-Waterman LPX2 vs panel
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
d3=sw.sort_values("SW_score",ascending=True)
c=["#4C78A8" if s.startswith(("EIS1","SEG1","PIL1","LSP1")) else "#E45756" for s in d3.subject]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(d3)),d3.SW_score,color=c)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(d3))); ax.set_yticklabels(d3.subject,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman score vs LPX2 (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1)")
ax.annotate("27.2% id over 905 columns",(782,len(d3)-1),xytext=(-8,0),
            textcoords="offset points",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8,color="white")
ax.set_title("C  Sequence similarity: only EIS1 is above background\n(blue = eisosome proteins, red = characterized lipases)",fontsize=9,loc="left")

# D: ancestral Eis1 distance + interactome
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labels=["K. lactis Eis1\n(Q6CTI0)","C. glabrata Eis1\n(Q6FKB4)"]
lp=[636,718]; ei=[1159,1489]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,lp,w,label="vs LPX2 (YKL050C)",color="#F58518")
ax.bar(x+w/2,ei,w,label="vs EIS1 (YMR031C)",color="#4C78A8")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("D  EIS1 retained the ancestral single-copy sequence;\nLPX2 is the diverged ohnolog (0/28 physical partners are eisosome proteins)",fontsize=9,loc="left")

fig.suptitle("LPX2 (P35736) has EIS1-family architecture and no alpha/beta-hydrolase fold or catalytic machinery",fontsize=12)
plt.show()

print(fs_core[["target","eval","cls"]].to_string(index=False))
